## Personality

Mrs. Wiley is known to be a holy terror who instills fear in those who work for her. Additionally, she does not attend church services often.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P108](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0108), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P2](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0002)_

## History

Wiley was a resident who formerly lived with [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), who secretly feared Wiley's eventual return. It was noted by local residents that Wiley originated from [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick).
